title: Aurangzeb Marathas And The Deccan
definition: The protracted military and political struggle between the Mughal Empire under Aurangzeb and the rising Maratha power, exacerbated by the annexation of Deccan Sultanates (Bijapur and Golconda).
importanceInUpsc: This topic is central to understanding the 'Deccan Ulcer' theory, the decline of the Mughal Empire, and the rise of regional powers in the 18th century.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Aurangzeb Marathas And The Deccan.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
